(rule!
  (let* ((serialized (list (map third (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells g)))))
         (xs (first serialized)))
    (if (empty? xs)
        (list (list 0) (list 0))
        (let loop ((remaining (rest xs))
                   (current (first xs))
                   (run-length 1)
                   (colors (list))
                   (lengths (list)))
          (if (empty? remaining)
              (list (reverse (cons current colors))
                    (reverse (cons run-length lengths)))
              (let ((next (first remaining)))
                (if (= next current)
                    (loop (rest remaining) current (+ run-length 1) colors lengths)
                    (loop (rest remaining) next 1
                          (cons current colors)
                          (cons run-length lengths)))))))))
